info.name: Ticketat API
info.description:
Ticketat REST API v1.

Select the **Ticketat Local** environment, then run Auth → Register or Login: the token is saved and used by every protected request.

Conventions: docs/api/conventions.md

request.description:
Create an account and get a token for this device. Saves the token to the environment.

Rate limit: 5/min per email + IP.

Docs: docs/api/authentication.md

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description:
Sign in with email and password. Saves the token to the environment.

Rate limit: 5/min per email + IP.

Docs: docs/api/authentication.md

response.name: 401 Wrong credentials

request.description:
Revokes only the token used in this request. Clears the token from the environment.

Docs: docs/api/authentication.md

item.name: Google
item.description:
1. Send **Redirect** and open `data.url` in a browser.
2. Approve, then copy the `code` query parameter from the URL Google redirects to.
3. Paste it in the `googleCode` environment variable and send **Callback** within a few minutes (codes are single use).

Requires GOOGLE_* values in api/.env. Docs: docs/api/authentication.md

request.description: Exchanges the Google code for an API token. Creates or links the account. Saves the token to the environment.

response.name: 401 Invalid code
422 Email not verified by Google

item.description: Owners manage everyone; managers manage staff only. An organization keeps at least one owner. Docs: docs/api/organizations.md
